## Summary

- Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- List the checks you ran (build, `bash -n`, unit tests, on-board tests) and the image version or board you tested on.

## Commit messages

Every commit must follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md): an English Conventional Commit subject and a `Message` block with `en` and `zh` summaries. Pull requests are rebase-merged, so the commit messages are published as they are and feed the release changelogs. The pull request title follows the same subject rules.
